purpose: Per-slot color index (6 slots) for the variant-B 6-slot summon-spell animation state machine; selects, per slot, which row of the local per-color vertical row-offset table is used when blitting that slot's sprite.
logic_summary: Zero-bss runtime state written and read exclusively by fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_b_6slot (0x26BFD..0x26E34). INIT state (state_code==0) seeds slot i with i (store @ 0x26C78). The TICK frame-7 color-rotation path (frame counter hits 7 with terminate_flag==0) stores rotation_counter%10 into the slot (store @ 0x26D75), so values stay in 0..9. In every TICK frame the value is read (@ 0x26DD1) and used as the index into the 40-byte local per-color vertical row-offset table copy aiStack_3c (origin_y + aiStack_3c[color]) passed to fd2_blit_indexed_sprite. Sibling state arrays for the same machine: frame_counter_array (0x5401C, int[6]), jitter_byte_array (0x5404C, byte[6]); the color rotation source is data_fd2_battle_summon_anim_variant_b_color_rotation_counter (0x54052, mod-10 byte).
element_semantics: Each int32 element is the color index for one of the 6 animation slots: 0..9, a row index into the 10-entry per-color vertical row-offset table. Accessed as DWORD (stride 4); the read at 0x26DD1 uses the value as a *4-scaled array subscript, confirming int32. Index is always non-negative (seeded i in 0..5 or rotation_counter%10 in 0..9).
